messages:
Nadia: quick flag from a docs sweep: a handful of pages still show the old function_call payload and some structured-output examples use a top-level union array that breaks our parser tests. can we split into a small, safe plan?

Liam: yep. plan proposal: PR A = redirects + frontmatter fixes (low risk), PR B = snippet replacements + migration note + canonical compact-envelope page, PR C = small test harness + docs-linter rule to detect literal "function_call" in examples. keep PRs scoped.

Sam: i'll take PR A (redirects). please add the grep/links to the issue. i'll move files to /docs/legacy-examples/ and add a short legacy note in each moved file.

Nadia: added grep output in the issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/1255. hotspots: /docs/guides/tool-calling/, /docs/reference/parsers/, /docs/examples/python/ and one external post on aiops-weekly linking to an old slug.

Sam: created branch docs/redirects/toolcall-fix and opened PR A: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5401 - small moves + redirect stubs. tagging @Liam @Nadia.

LinkChecker: automated: preliminary linkcheck: 5 broken links found. failing refs list attached to PR artifact.

Liam: for PR B i'll prepare the canonical compact-envelope page under /docs/reference/parsers/compact-envelope-v2.md and update the snippets in /docs/guides/tool-calling/migration-short.md. unique twist: call out a new manifest-based registration for tools (tools/manifest.ts) in the TS snippets so authors don't accidentally shadow names.

Nadia: nice. also add a short example of the schema object using "$schema_version": "v2" so it's clear this page is authoritative for new clients.

Liam: draft compact-envelope example (will format on the page):
```json
{
  "envelope": {
    "tool_call": { "name": "classify_ticket", "args": {"text": "..."}},
    "output_schema": {"$schema_version": "v2", "type": "object", "properties": {"category": {"type": "string"}}, "required": ["category"]}
  }
}
```
This shows the versioned schema key we agreed for parser clarity.

Sam: PR A merged (redirects live). moved a couple files to legacy with short "moved for migration" notes.

Liam: PR B draft opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5409 - includes: compact-envelope page, updated python + ts snippets, an example showing tools manifest registration, and a 3-line migration snippet in /docs/migration.md that points to the canonical page.

Nadia: for snippets: propose showing both the new pattern and a compatibility shim for older SDKs. python example: 
```py
# new
resp = client.chat.completions.create(model='x', tools=[classify_ticket])
# shim for old SDKs (temporary)
resp = client.chat.completions.create(model='x', function_call={'name':'classify_ticket'})
```
and add a note recommending teams upgrade SDKs when possible.

Liam: i'll also add a tiny TS manifest example: 
```ts
// tools/manifest.ts
export const tools = [ classifyTicket ];
// usage
const resp = await client.chat.completions.create({ model: 'x', tools: tools });
```
This helps with discoverability in the docset.

DocBot: automated: docs preview build started for PR 5409: https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.io/preview/5409

Nadia: one more guardrail to add on the compact page: avoid union-of-arrays at top-level; prefer explicit objects with required properties. show a tiny counterexample.

Liam: added guardrails and a short parser-fallback paragraph: parser order = schema v2 -> compact-envelope -> heuristic json heuristics. also wired a note about quoting property names consistently.

Sam: PR B preview looks good, but the preview job flagged a frontmatter mismatch on /docs/reference/parsers/compact-envelope-v2.md (missing title). i'll add minimal frontmatter to fix the preview.

DocBot: automated: preview build updated, no remaining link errors in PR 5409 preview.

Liam: opened PR C: docs/tests/docs-lint-functioncall to add a small docs-linter rule that fails CI when an example contains the literal string "function_call". keeps future regressions out. PR C also adds a tiny pytest harness example under /docs/examples/parse-tests/parser_order.py. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5412

Nadia: love the linter. please make it a soft-fail for 1 week (warning) then enforce. also add a README in /docs/legacy-examples/ explaining how to request restoration of moved examples.

Sam: PR C merged; linter added as a warn-only check initially. parse-order test added with instructions in the test file header.

Liam: PR B merged after small frontmatter fix. migration note in /docs/migration.md updated and includes links to compact-envelope-v2 and manifest examples. :tada:

Nadia: great work. follow-ups: 1) i'll open an issue to sweep community/partner blog links next week (aiops-weekly is the first), 2) after one week we flip the docs-linter from warn to fail, 3) keep an eye on the SDK repos and coordinate a small release note for the tooling change. closing the thread unless there are more flags.

Sam: thanks all 680. if anyone sees stray old snippets ping me and i'll spin a small follow-up.
